bio.text: Carey Coleman, a Republican, won the May 2026 primary for Ohio's 13th Congressional District over four opponents and faces Democratic Rep. Emilia Sykes in the November general election.
He is a former radio talk show host for WNIR-FM and previously worked as a television meteorologist, both nationally and in Cleveland.

sources.title: 2026 Ohio Primary: Challengers set in 5th, 6th and 13th Districts
